Its cubic specialization has unit full-span rank-two speeds, nonconical determinant one, and acceleration outside the constant quadratic speed span. The exact weight-three initial relation has a nonconstant coefficient on the bad initial; the coordinate-initial algebra is strictly smaller than the full graded ring. This is an explicit already recognized action, not a globally minimal frame or a new general recognition theorem.
